text:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — ACME just asked for org SSO + VPC for the pilot. Sales says it's a blocker for their pilot start next month. Need decision on MVP vs v1 and rollout path.
Jordan (Sales): confirming — they want SSO + dedicated VPC + audit logs. Pilot kickoff is tentatively 4/20. If we can't meet that, they may push.
Anna (Product): that's a heavy ask for MVP. Do we have a minimal implementation that gets them unblocked without full Private product?
Ravi (Eng): technical quick take: SSO (SAML) is doable as a scoped feature in ~2 sprints if we deprioritize a couple of non-blocking items. VPC + customer-managed networking is infra-heavy — probably 6+ weeks.
Evan (Infra): +1. Full VPC/private control plane needs KMS work, network docs, and hardened deployment tests. We could ship a "pilot-only" managed VPC as a stopgap but it's still several weeks.
Sam (Design): any SSO UX we can ship fast? A simple settings page + SAML metadata upload should be fine for MVP pilot.
Maya (PM): trade options: (A) Accept SSO for MVP, postpone VPC to v1; (B) Push pilot date and deliver both in v1; (C) Build a narrow VPC pilot path (internal effort) and keep timeline. Thoughts?
Jordan (Sales): customer prefers (A) if legal signs off on data boundaries. They may accept host-managed network for pilot if we provide guarantees + SOC report.
Anna (Product): we need a clear acceptance criteria list for the pilot to avoid scope creep. Suggest we do SSO + audit logs + explicit data residency notes. VPC becomes v1.
Ravi (Eng): realistic breakdown: SAML SSO + metadata flow + basic audit logs = 2 weeks (2 devs). Hardening + KMS + VPC orchestration = 6 weeks (infra + security).
Evan (Infra): dependencies: internal KMS integration, egress controls, and tenancy isolation tests. If we go pilot-managed-VPC, that's 4 weeks but with higher risk.
Maya (PM): proposal: move SSO + audit logs into MVP scope, ship a technical compatibility doc for pilot, and schedule VPC for v1. Also set a formal pilot guardrail: no PHI, limited tenant count, rollback SLA.
Sam (Design): can mock the SSO flow today, will drop a gated prototype by EOD.
Ravi (Eng): if we reallocate sprint capacity, we can target SSO+audit in two weeks. Need to defer: embeddings-cache improvements and noncritical admin UX polish.
Anna (Product): list the deferred items explicitly so Sales can't claim they were hidden cuts. I'll update the cutlist and announce in roadmap channel.
Jordan (Sales): that's fine with ACME. They want a pilot checklist and a one-pager describing what"s included vs reserved for v1.
Maya (PM): action items: @Anna update cutlist + pilot one-pager; @Ravi estimate microtasks and confirm deps; @Evan assess risk and give pilot-managed-VPC ETA as fallback; @Sam ship SSO mocks. We'll reconvene in 24h.
DeployBot: Reminder — next sprint planning meeting scheduled in 48h (link: https://calendar.redwood/next-sprint).
Ravi (Eng): noted. Starting a thread in eng-platform to capture KMS/tenant tests.
Evan (Infra): I'll try to scope a minimal managed-VPC runbook and share costs by EOD.
Anna (Product): posted cutlist draft: 1) keep SSO+audit (MVP pilot), 2) delay embeddings cache work, 3) move admin polish to v1. Link: https://docs.redwood/internal/pilot-cutlist (private).
Jordan (Sales): ACME okayed the plan tentatively. They want a legal checklist by next Tue.
Maya (PM): good. If legal flags data residency or encryption requirements we may need to revisit. For now this is the scope negotiation outcome: MVP = SSO + audit logs + pilot checklist; V1 = VPC/private deployment + KMS integration + broader tenancy.
Sam (Design): will push the SSO flow + copy for pilot one-pager in the next push. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng): i'll drop a thin PR with the SAML endpoints and basic test harness in 48h.
Evan (Infra): posting managed-VPC cost/ops plan in #eng-infra in 4h.
Maya (PM): thanks team. We'll keep timeline optimistic but note risk to stakeholders. Reconvene 24h. :eyes:
